name: 西安交大西游记
english_name: Xi'an Jiaotong University Journey to the West (Huanle Yuan)
english_description: Version 4.50 of "Mythical World: Journey to the West," branded in-game as Huanle Yuan ("Garden of Joy," subtitled "A Journey to the West, College Edition") — a MUD affiliated with the Terracotta Warriors BBS at Xi'an Jiaotong University.
